turns.text: That is our firewood pile. I cover it with a tarp every night, but it sits right against the wall.
The brush is what I cut last weekend. I have not hauled it away yet, it is still green.
This fence is old cedar. It was here when we bought the place.

findings.instruction: Move the pile away from the wall or keep it fully covered with fire-resistant material, not just a night tarp.
findings.reason: Frames show an uncovered wood pile stacked right against the house wall.

findings.instruction: Replace the old cedar fence section by the house with fire-resistant material.
findings.reason: Frames show a wooden fence meeting the house wall.

findings.instruction: Haul away the cut brush pile from near the house right away.
findings.reason: Frames show a pile of dead-looking branches on the ground close to the house.
